subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Varied**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Varied **means diverse or differing in various ways; having a variety of elements. (विभिन्न तरीकों से विविध या भिन्न; विभिन्न प्रकार के तत्व होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The museum had a varied collection of artefacts from different time periods and cultures.*
 
 
 
• In the context of people who hitchhike talking about their experiences, it suggests that the experiences are not uniform or identical but rather diverse and differing from one another.
 
• "**Varied experiences**" is a common collocation used to express the diversity of encounters or situations that individuals may face.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Worried: **Anxious, troubled, or concerned about something. (किसी बात को लेकर चिंतित, परेशान या चिंतित होना)
 
• **Conversant: **Knowledgeable or familiar with a particular subject or skill; able to converse or talk about it. (किसी विशेष विषय या कौशल का जानकार या परिचित; इसके बारे में बातचीत या बात करने में सक्षम)
 
• **Emptied: **Drained or removed the contents; made something empty. (सामग्री को सूखाया या हटा दिया गया; कुछ खाली कर दिया)
